payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods used to reduce data sparsity effects in neural machine translation (NMT) systems, including data augmentation techniques and sub-word segmentation.

claims.text: Data augmentation methods were employed to increase the amount of training data, helping NMT systems cope with low-resourced situations.
Sub-word segmentation techniques, such as BPE, allow NMT to learn translations with considerably fewer data.
Mix-source methods are considered useful for alleviating data sparsity in low-resourced settings.
